examples.en: The technician will install the new software on all office computers today.
examples.zh: 技術人員今天會在所有辦公室電腦上安裝新軟體。

examples.en: The installation of the new phone system takes about two hours.
examples.zh: 新電話系統的安裝大約需要兩小時。

examples.en: The installer arrived early and finished the work before lunch.
examples.zh: 安裝人員提早抵達，並在午餐前完成了工作。
